authorization: Explicit user instruction to add AH opening-consistency / company-divergence audit into MODEL_1 during the formal freeze.
purpose: Detect genuine same-information-regime AH disagreement without letting isolated non-mainstream books distort the core market consensus.

core_consensus.when_core_is_split_between_adjacent_quar: Preserve the band, e.g. -0.5/-0.75, instead of pretending the market literally quoted -0.625.

price_and_ladder_qc.if_ladder_missing: Keep price compensation as uncertainty; do not manufacture an equivalent line.

grades.D0: No material divergence: within core band, <= one quarter-goal step with plausible price explanation, or data/QC prevents a genuine disagreement claim.
grades.D1: Mild/isolated divergence: typically one company, one slice, one-quarter to two-quarter step gap, or an outlier that quickly converges.
grades.D2: Material genuine divergence: verified MAIN line, same-time/same-regime gap of at least two quarter-goal steps (0.5 goal) that is not explained by water/ladder and persists across at least two comparable slices, or remains divergent through a core reprice.
grades.D3: Cluster split: at least two independent verified secondary companies each show persistent material divergence from the core cluster, or a verified secondary cluster reprices materially opposite to the core across multiple comparable slices. Operator independence must be known or D3 is not allowed.

formal_interpretation.persistent_shallow_vs_favourite: Material counterevidence to favourite AH cover strength; must be explained against 1X2, OU, attraction and lifecycle.
formal_interpretation.persistent_deep_vs_favourite: Material support for favourite AH cover strength only after attraction and price compensation are audited.

anti_error_examples.not_genuine_divergence: Core -0.75 while a secondary book shows -0.25 hours earlier before a material information event, or its -0.25 is an ALT/display line.
anti_error_examples.genuine_candidate: Core books remain around -0.5/-0.75 at the same time while a verified secondary book stays MAIN -0.25 without extreme price compensation across multiple slices.
anti_error_examples.cluster_split_candidate: Two independent verified secondary books remain MAIN -0.25 while the core cluster moves from -0.5 to -0.75 and the secondary cluster refuses to follow or moves the other way.
